closed_reference.constants: K=E_XML/[3(1-2nu_XML)], Mf=Kw/n0 with n0=double(float(XMLPorosity)); B=Mf/(K+Mf). Reference uses nominal XML E/nu and actual float initial porosity; production rounded elastic constants remain distinct. No fit.
closed_reference.targets: p=B*q0; effective diagonal=-K*q0/(K+Mf), shear0; total diagonal=-q0; fixed-origin uvec=alpha*x0 with alpha=-q0/[3(K+Mf)]. Shell target uses each fixed initial r0, not a single surface radius.
closed_reference.original_five_definitions: Copied mechanically from cryer_preload_probe_r1.py:87–138: initial-native-volume-weighted pressure-target RMS100Pa; six stored total-stress component target RMS100Pa (mean over six, not Frobenius); maximum speed1e-5m/s; fixed-origin SINGLE-scalar isotropic-fit full-vector residual RMS1e-5mm; fixed initial shell per-particle inward target-error RMS1e-5mm. No translation/tensor fit enters the criterion. Additionally report the unfitted theoretical full-vector displacement error, with no new threshold.
closed_reference.interpretation: These are the original conditional homogeneous undrained initial-state diagnostics, not exact transient theory during ramp, a post-drain uniform-stress gate or full physical admission. Each of four states is reported separately; no averaging hides failures. A completed analysis may report all_five_closed_diagnostics_passed=false while passed=true means only the bounded offline analysis/schema completed. Failures never launch anything.
